subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five memory role slots, including per-agent overrides and hook-level role gating, as the permanent public configuration and plugin API contract?
rationale: Correctness review cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently support all five role concepts and their inheritance semantics; this commits core config, Doctor migrations, SDK types, hooks, plugin lifecycle behavior, and session routing to a long-term taxonomy.

options.title: Sponsor the role contract
options.body: Approve the five-role architecture in principle, then require conflict resolution and exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Land only roles with fully defined runtime invocation semantics and defer dreaming or user-model ownership to a later API proposal.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while declining this branch until maintainers choose a different memory composition model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the five-role architecture in principle, then require conflict resolution and exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner for a permanent cross-cutting product and plugin API commitment, with memory owner review supplied by `vignesh07`.
